[Story]
Recently, Xiaohua comes back from abroad and attends a banquet. At the table, the host brings a lot of Maotai liquor. Not long after the start, Xiaohua's friend, the experienced wine taster Xiaozhang, takes a sip of the Maotai on the table and says, "Maotai is different, it tastes good.", then finds an excuse to switch to red wine.

[Question]
What does Xiaozhang really mean when he says this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Xiaozhang thinks the variety of wines at this banquet should be more diverse
B. Xiaozhang thinks the quality of Maotai is better than red wine
C. Xiaozhang hints that the host's Maotai may not be real
D. Xiaozhang likes to drink red wine, not Maotai
